english.title: Operator fail to assist inspector regarding identification / examination of animals and taking of samples
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse, failed to comply with the reasonable request of an inspector, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), under regulation 7 of the Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018, to facilitate the identification and examination of an animal and the taking of samples in accordance with regulation 6 of the Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 20(1)(b) and (2) of the Animal Welfare (Licensing of Activities Involving Animals) (England) Regulations 2018.
